title: Gov.uk has replaced Stripe with Dutch provider Adyen
summary: The UK Government Digital Service (GDS) has replaced Stripe with Dutch fintech company Adyen as its payment processing provider. This is a significant shift for one of Europe's largest government digital services, with GDS citing 'building for the future' as the motivation for the switch. The move highlights how major government tech contracts can shift between major payment providers based on scalability, cost, or feature requirements.
problem_solved: Gov.uk needed a more scalable or future-ready payment infrastructure to handle government digital transactions efficiently.
why_valuable: This represents a significant government tech contract win for Adyen and demonstrates how large institutions continuously evaluate their payment infrastructure providers for better scalability and cost-effectiveness.
